0: Soldiers are all-round solid fighters, and they can capture or repair villages to give you benefits.
1: With their powerful bows archers can attack from a distance and are especially efficient against airborne enemies.
2: Water elementals are friends of the water. When in water, they become much more stronger.
3: They are skilled in the use of necromancy. Sorceresses are weak in melee combat but they can summon skeletons from the dead to aid you in the battle.
4: These mystical beings of pure light have an aura that can remove negative effects from your allies and heal them a little bit.
5: Wolves are fearsome hunters with very high motility. They travel very fast on land and kill enemies with their poisonous bites.
6: Golems are ancient beings, incredibly strong in physical defence and are even stronger when in the mountains.
7: Catapults blaze a trail of destruction with their enormous attack range. However they have very low motility.
8: These massive flying beasts have ruled the sky since ancient times. They have very high motility and deadly melee attacks.
9: Commander is the heart of an army. He has quite strong battle skills and can capture enemy castles.
10: Skeletons are undead beings summoned by necromancers. They are not very strong but have poisonous attacks.
12: Paladins are holy armies who are skilled at healing and can also capture villages like soldiers do.
13: Berserkers are born fighters. The more enemies are around them the stronger they become.
14: Ghosts are mystical undead beings. They float above the ground and can blind enemies with their attacks.
15: Black mages are skilled at using dark magic. Their attacks are always powerful against those with low magic defence.
16: Wolfarchers are high mobility version of archers. They can strike almost anywhere you want them to attack.
17: Ice elementals are mystical beings formed by pure ice. It seems they can fight well both in water and on land.
18: Mystic creatures. It seems their soft body can absorb a lot of damages.
19: Mermaids are graceful sea-dwellers who strike with their tridents. Like water elementals, they fight best when near the water.
20: Druids channel the magic of nature itself. Their spells grow more potent the longer they stand their ground.
